text:
maria: quick check on alert rule row UX: per-channel control verbs and preview header.
ashok: main issue: mixed "Mute" vs "Suppress" vs "Pause" in copy. pick one.
lucy: users liked "Pause notifications" in tests because it implies time. prefer that for primary action.
harry: minor a11y: pills are not tabbable. make them buttons with aria-pressed and clear focus ring.
design-bot: prototype: https://figma.com/s/redwood/alerts-pause-v1 (comments: pill-accessibility, toast-copy)
sam: toast wording proposal: "Notifications paused for Slack  2 hours  Undo" (include channel name, human duration, Undo).
maria: inline state copy: use "Notifications: on" / "Notifications: off" — consistent noun phrase helps scan.
ashok: also increase pill font to 14px and ensure WCAG AA contrast. provide reduced-motion fallback for animations.
lucy: preview header: change "Who will be notified" to "Alert recipients and channels"  concise and clearer.
maria: action items: ashok - update pill component + aria examples; harry - focus/keyboard flow; sam - update toast copy strings; lucy - update preview header in figma.
harry: will add keyboard examples and a sample aria-label: "PagerDuty, notifications paused for 30 minutes".
maria: thanks all, will reconvene in next design review if there are unresolved items.
